items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Mr. Groschel told Pierones that it would be better to put me in the band

ctx.x: Some pictures I've seen of him, he looks a little bit like Peter Boccage.

Yeah, well, you wouldn't know whether he was a white or what he was, see. But, at those, just around that time he was turning, he was turning to that wine, that drinking, see. One of the greatest trumpet players that ever was. He played with number one Ringling Brothers band, the white band. He sat in the band. And when Zoo carried me there, he always says, a trumpet player? So and so was the case, and he passed me on the show, he said, come on, sit down, here's my horn. That just gave him a chance to go walk…
